title: Experts disagree on new runtime/hooks/stage-agent-start.mjs
context:
Chief architect: the nine claims do not contradict; they group on one file. This one is the trust boundary the entry gate depends on, and it settles the open choice in the fallback test (whether a failed run stamps the marker: it must not). The other claims (exact matcher plus safe id, thin hook, log message only, no-op on other route, boundary and non-stage tests) all hold alongside it.

Target: new runtime/hooks/stage-agent-start.mjs
- security-auditor: the hook writes the per-agent entry marker only when agent_type matches the exact stage-helper pattern and agent_id is non-empty after the existing safeFileKey sanitising, so no other agent and no crafted id can earn an entry pass or write outside .paqad/session/agent-entry/
- security-auditor: the marker is written only after the brief was built and printed, so a helper that got no brief keeps today's blocked-until-loaded path instead of passing the entry gate with neither the brief nor the framework loaded
- security-auditor: on error the hook logs only the error message to .paqad/logs/hooks.log, never the brief text or the raw payload
- application-architect: the hook stays thin like stage-agent-completion.mjs: resolve root, stand down when disabled or not the active route, call dist functions, print, stamp the marker; all brief logic stays in src so it is unit-tested under the coverage gate
- qa-engineer: Given a SubagentStart payload whose agent_type is paqad-expert, paqad:paqad-chief-architect, paqad-foo, Explore, or missing, when the hook runs, then it exits 0, prints nothing, and writes no file under .paqad/session/agent-entry/ (unit, real script)
- qa-engineer: Given buildStageBrief throws or dist/stage-isolation/stage-brief.js is missing, when the hook runs, then it exits 0, prints nothing, and appends one stage-agent-start line to .paqad/logs/hooks.log; the test also asserts whether the per-agent entry marker was written, so the fallback path is pinned either way (unit)
- qa-engineer: stamping .paqad/session/agent-entry/<agent_id> when the brief was not delivered lets a helper edit with neither the brief nor the framework loaded, a quiet hole in the agent-entry-gate.mjs guarantee; stamp only after the brief is printed
- qa-engineer: Given a stage agent_type but no agent_id, or an agent_id with path characters such as ../, when the hook runs, then no marker is written outside .paqad/session/agent-entry/ and the hook still exits 0 (unit, boundary)
- qa-engineer: Given paqad disabled, a repo never onboarded, or a session whose hook route is the other install route, when the hook runs, then it is a no-op (no stdout, no marker), so npm and plugin together never produce two briefs (unit, both routes)
